title: Sate Match
pitch: Build the skewer in the specified order, then answer a quiz.

gameplay.goal: Assemble the correct satay ingredient order.
coreLoop: Correct skewer awards points and immediately opens quiz
gameplay.winCondition: Score points for correct sticks until the round ends.
gameplay.loseCondition: Lose all hearts or reach the time limit.
gameplay.resetBehavior: Clear current skewer only, retain order, score, hearts, multiplier and timer.
rules: One heart lost only on wrong completed skewer; score unchanged
Quiz correct adds 0.5 multiplier; quiz wrong has no penalty
Time freezes through quiz result display and resumes on quiz close

artDirection.motion: CSS food entry and WebP FX

acceptanceCriteria: Validate reversed tap order against displayed order
Reset clears picks only, preserving score, timer and hearts
Quiz opens after every successful stick and pauses timer
Game fits mobile portrait and centers on desktop
